 From Hydrating Masks to Milky Toners, These Are the 20 Best K-Beauty Products for Glass Skin
 Cosmopolitan Follow Beth Gillette, Jasmine Hyman Fri, November 6, 2026 at 4:02 PM UTC Add to Preferred Sources Fri, November 6, 2026 at 4:02 PM UTC The 20 Best K-Beauty Products Available Stateside Jasmine Hyman for Cosmopolitan "Hearst Magazines and Yahoo may earn commission or revenue on some items through these links." 
 Quick Overview AESTURA ATOBARRIER365 Cream Moisturizer
 $21 at sephora.com Medicube Booster Pro X2 7-in-1 Glow Beauty Device
 $249 at amazon.com BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask
 $19 at amazon.com Beauty of Joseon Day Dew Sunscreen
 $18 at sephora.com BIODANCE Collagen Peptide Eye Patches,
 $23 at sephora.com See 15 more Korean skincare has officially taken over stateside shelves. Between hydrating milky toners and viral face masks promising that coveted glass skin overnight, K-beauty products have become permanent fixtures in our routines. And according to Charlotte Cho, cofounder of Soko Glam and founder of Then I Met You , K-beauty is about far more than a 10-step routine or a sheet mask obsession. "K-beauty is more than just a trend; it's a skincare philosophy and way of life," she says. "It's how you think about skincare and what works best for your unique skin needs."
 And honestly, there's never been a better time to dive in. As the beauty industry shifts toward skin health, skin barrier repair, and holistic routines, consumers are increasingly looking to Korean skincare for innovation-first formulas. Cosmo 's beauty team has flown across the world to Seoul to meet with K-beauty founders, learn from chemists, and stroll the aisles of Olive Young (Korea's version of Sephora) to find all the best K-beauty skincare products. Here's all of the best K-Beauty skincare products, according to editors who have tested hundreds.
 Advertisement Advertisement Ahead, from snail mucin serums that flood skin with hydration to high-tech beauty devices that mimic an in-office facial, these are the best Korean skincare products for achieving the glass skin of your dreams.
 1) AESTURA ATOBARRIER365 Cream Moisturizer
 AESTURA ATOBARRIER365 Cream Moisturizer 
 Why we love it: Aestura is one of the hottest K-beauty brands right now—and Cosmo editors are very grateful that it finally landed on shelves in Sephora. This ultra-hydrating cream is so rich and cushiony, and it can even double as an overnight mask. You can't go wrong with any of the barrier-protecting formulas, but this moisturizer is a great place to start.
 One Cosmo editor says: "I love the concept of slugging so much, but basically every slugging product on the market is a nightmare for my acne-prone skin. Instead of an ointment-y formula, I started using this ultra-rich cream from Aestura. It's fantastic for sensitive skin (doesn't break me out or irritate me at all), but it also moisturizes the eff outta my skin. I even will put it on my elbows, knees, and any dry patches on my body because it's that hydrating."
—BETH GILLETTE, BEAUTY EDITOR
 Pros Great for all-over use
 Ideal for sensitive skin
 Cons Might not be the best option for acne-prone skin
 $21 at sephora.com 2) Medicube Booster Pro X2 7-in-1 Glow Beauty Device
 Medicube Booster Pro X2 7-in-1 Glow Beauty Device 
 Why we love it: Don't get me wrong, all the hydrating serums and masks are great for achieving glass skin, but this device will crank them up to the next level. This booster does exactly what it sounds like—it boosts your formulas, so they penetrate into the skin even deeper and increase ingredient effectiveness. It's also got LED, microcurrent, and more to leave your face looking smooth and lifted.
 One Cosmo editor says: "I've used the original Booster Pro extensively, but I got the inside scoop in Seoul to try out the new Booster Pro 2. And it's so much better. The overall experience of the device is more powerful, meaning each of the six levels is more impactful than the original Booster Pro. It lets your skincare go deeper, your facial muscles feel more activated, and overall delivers a more intense treatment experience. Since it's more powerful, it may take some time to work up to the higher settings. Plus, the larger head size takes up more surface area on the skin, making application more efficient, especially across the full face and jawline." —JASMINE HYMAN, ASSISTANT BEAUTY EDITOR
 READ OUR FULL REVIEW 
 Pros Intuitive and easy to use, even if you're not tech-y
 Combines five different treatments in one (LED, microcurrent, airshot, dermashot, and mask mode)
 Suitable for a wide range of skin types and issues
 Cons Need to build up to the higher levels (otherwise, you could experience some discomfort or redness)
 $249 at amazon.com 3) BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask
 BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask 
 Why we love it: Chances are you've seen this glass skin–inducing mask on your social media feed at some point (it also has more than 10,000 five-star reviews on Amazon). You simply put it on your face before bed, and you'll wake up with drenched and glossy skin thanks to the loads of collagen and hyaluronic acid.
 One Cosmo editor says: "I could go on forever about how much I love this viral mask that you leave on overnight for glowy skin. It's already cut in two pieces to help it fit perfectly over your face (which I loved sm). Then, just go to sleep. That's it. In the morning, you'll notice the mask has absorbed and is completely clear, leaving you with the smoothest skin ever." —BG
 Pros Visibly hydrates the skin
 Comfortably fits on the face
 Cons A bit hard to sleep with
 $19 at amazon.com 4) Beauty of Joseon Day Dew Sunscreen
 Beauty of Joseon Day Dew Sunscreen 
 Why we love it: Korea is beloved for its sunscreen formulas, largely because they have approved filters that we don't have access to in America. But this one is available for purchase stateside and has a similar cosmetically elegant formula to what's available in Asia. It hydrates with panthenol and hyaluronic acid, and soothes skin with niacinamide, plus protects with SPF 50.
 One Cosmo editor says: "I bought two tubes of Beauty of Joseon sunscreen when I was in Seoul, and while the same exact formula isn't available here yet, this hydrating SPF comes pretty close. It sinks into the skin so nicely without leaving behind a white cast, and doesn't break me out, which is always a win in my acne-prone skin's book."—JH
 Pros Non-comedogenic
 Hydrating ingredients
 SPF 50
 Cons Not the exact formula available in Korea
 $18 at sephora.com 5) BIODANCE Collagen Peptide Eye Patches,
 BIODANCE Collagen Peptide Eye Patches, 
 Why we love it: These eye patches pack a lot of punch into one jar. They're filled with a host of nourishing ingredients like caffeine, glycerin, niacinamide, peptides, and more. And in addition to their smoothing, hydrating, and de-puffing benefits, the textured gel helps grip the skin so they're easy to wear while you walk around the house or run some errands (no outside eye patch judgement here).
 One Cosmo editor says: "If I'm in my apartment, there's a 100 percent chance I'm wearing these eye patches. I store the jar in my fridge, so I get an extra shot of de-puffing alongside the infused caffeine. It's also got a nice gripping texture, so they're never sliding down my face." —JH
 Pros Non-slip texture
 Comes in a few different versions depending on your under-eye needs
 Cons The spatula it comes with is a little difficult to use, but fingers work just fine
 $23 at sephora.com 6) Torriden Collagen Firming Eye Cream
 Torriden Collagen Firming Eye Cream 
 Why we love it: If you're looking to banish dark circles and fine lines, this eye cream is packed with a collagen-peptide and a retinol complex, and tons of hyaluronic acid to address signs of aging. It's a favorite among K-beauty lovers in Seoul and stateside.
 One Cosmo editor says: "My under-eye circles stay purple no matter how much sleep I get. But this cream has done the seemingly impossible and made my dark circles less noticeable. I used to never be able to skip concealer, and for the last month I've hardly needed it. I will be restocking on this as soon as I'm out." —JH
 Pros Can also be used on other parts of the face
 Retinol complex isn't irritating
 Cons Those with super sensitive under-eyes might want to use it only at night
 $23 at amazon.com 7) Medicube Zero Pore Pads
 Medicube Zero Pore Pads 
 Why we love it: Alix Earle's derm recommended these toner pads, and now they're quite literally all over TikTok. (But Team Cosmo has loved them for years.) They're filled with two types of exfoliants—AHAs to help smooth the top layer of the skin and BHAs to go deep into pores to help clean out clogged oil or dirt.
 One Cosmo editor says : "I picked these up after suffering a gnarly travel breakout upon my arrival in Asia, and by the time I left, my skin was back to its usual state with all of my zits healing. I really love swiping these all over my face in the mornings (followed with sunscreen, ofc). I legit feel like my skin starts to look better as the day goes on—it's kinda magic." —BG
 Pros Sweeps the skin without dehydrating
 Great for acne
 Cons Not the most travel-friendly since the jar is quite big
 $19 at amazon.com 8) Rejuran Dual Effect Ampoule c-PDRN 0.5% Rejuvenating Serum
 Rejuran Dual Effect Ampoule c-PDRN 0.5% Rejuvenating Serum 
 Why we love it: Rejuran is a beloved in-clinic treatment in Korea that utilizes PDRN (aka salmon sperm) to amp up collagen production, and this U.S.-available skincare line brings that same PDRN-centric routine to your bathroom sink. It's also got squalane and niacinamide to hydrate and soothe the skin.
 One Cosmo editor says: "I was initially skeptical of PDRN skincare, but Rejuran's serum here (it utilizes salmon-derived DNA, squalane, and niacinamide) has converted me into a believer. I've been using it as the first step in my a.m. routine for a month straight, and my skin looks bouncier and smoother as a result. The silky texture gives an immediate glow too, so I look forward to using it every morning." —LB
 Pros Great for texture and plumpness
 Cons Might not be the best option for acne-prone skin
 $55 at sephora.com 9) HARUHARU Wonder Black Rice Probiotics Barrier Essence
 HARUHARU Wonder Black Rice Probiotics Barrier Essence 
 Why we love it: Essences are a well-loved skincare step in Korea. Many aestheticians there recommend even patting one into your skin between every single product in your routine. Regardless of how often you use it, though, this one is extremely moisturizing. Packed with ceramides, oils, shea butter, and rice extract, its watery texture is deceptively rich, adding an extra layer of hydration without the added weight.
 One Cosmo editor says: "My skin truly looks like glass when I use this essence. I pat it onto damp skin, and it doesn't fully sink in; instead, it leaves a glowy veil over my skin. It's perfect before makeup when I want my skin to look majorly radiant." —BG
 Pros Has a lightweight consistency but is surprisingly moisturizing
 Cons Contains a few oils and butters that could be potentially pore-clogging for acne-prone skin
 $20 at amazon.com 10) Dr.Jart+ Premium Beauty Balm Korean Tinted Moisturizer with SPF 30
 Dr.Jart+ Premium Beauty Balm Korean Tinted Moisturizer with SPF 30 
 Why we love it: Dr Jart's BB Cream combines the coverage of a lightweight foundation, the hydration of a serum, and SPF 30 all into one bottle. It's got 8 flexible shades and the ingredient list is free of any potentially pore-clogging ingredients.
 One Cosmo editor says: "I've pretty much sworn off foundation because I hate when it feels too heavy on my face, but this is the closest thing to the coverage of a foundation, without the overly cakey feeling. It's great for my dry and sensitive skin, and covers all my blemishes and dark circles while neutralizing redness—making my skin concealer-optional." —JH
 Pros Safe for acne-prone skin
 Combines SPF, coverage, and hydration
 Cons While the shades are flexible, we wish there were more options
 $49 at sephora.com 11) ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing UVLOCK SPF 45
 ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing UVLOCK SPF 45 
 Why we love it: A hydrating sunscreen that also doesn't make you break out? Sounds like heaven. It also sounds like this Hydro Sun Barrier Cream from beloved K-beauty brand Round lab. It's got SPF 45 and it's loaded with tons of hydrating and soothing ingredients that let it double as a moisturizer.
 One Cosmo editor says: "I have dry skin, and many sunscreens feel too chalky on my face. But this one from Round Lab feels like a nice hydrator rather than a traditional SPF, making it so easy to throw on everyday. And it's non-comedogenic, so you don't have to worry about any pore cloggers."—JH
 Pros Great for dry skin types
 Acne-safe
 Cons Not as serum-y as the true Korean sunscreens
 $25 at ulta.com 12) COSRX Snail Mucin Essence
 COSRX Snail Mucin Essence 
 Why we love it: Snail mucin is beloved for its power to deeply hydrate the skin (it sounds gross, but it works) and it's great for slugging the skin without clogging pores.
 One Cosmo editor says : "This essence has def been a worthwhile addition to my skincare routine. It's relatively affordable and can be easily incorporated into any existing regimen if you're looking to add some ~vitality~ to your face and soothe damaged skin. The product is incredibly gentle and not a huge investment, so you can use it generously and daily too." —IMAN BALAGAM, CONTRIBUTING BEAUTY WRITER
 Pros Great for overnight use
 Acne-safe
 Cons Leaves behind slight residue
 $16 at amazon.com 13) ANUA PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 Serum
 ANUA PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 Serum 
 Why we love it: This serum is super popular in Korea, and it's basically glass skin in a bottle. Packed with PDRN (a salmon DNA-derived ingredient that boosts skin health) and hyaluronic acid, the lightweight serum deeply hydrates, plumps, and smooths skin while boosting radiance. The fast-absorbing formula leaves behind a fresh glow without ever feeling sticky or heavy, making it perfect for layering into any skincare routine.
 One Cosmo editor says: "I just picked this up at Olive Young during my trip to Seoul when my face was going through it from long travel days. This immediately quenched my dry skin and left my complexion looking basically reflective." —JH
 Pros Loaded with PDRN—a buzzy ingredient in Korea
 Hydrating and boosts collagen
 Cons Might not be the best option for acne-prone skin
 $27 at amazon.com 14) Medicube Collagen Overnight Wrapping Peel Off Mask
 Medicube Collagen Overnight Wrapping Peel Off Mask 
 Why we love it: Another TikTok favorite, because virality is basically synonymous with K-beauty at this point. You simply squeeze out some of this collagen-filled gel, lather it on your face, and it turns into a peel-off mask overnight. It truly creates the glassiest finish that you won't even wanna put makeup on top of.
 One Cosmo editor says: "As much as I loooooveeee the idea of wearing my collagen sheet masks overnight, I am a side sleeper so they fall right off. This peel-off mask, though, does basically the same thing without the frustration. My face looks so freaking smooth and buttery by morning. I do it before every big event." —BG
 Pros Noncomedogenic
 Gives the epitome of glass skin
 Cons We wish the bottle was bigger, it’s easy to use up
 $19 at amazon.com 15) VT COSMETICS Cica Reedle Shot 100
 VT COSMETICS Cica Reedle Shot 100 
 Why we love it: Okay, let me give you the rundown on spicules if you're unfamiliar. This serum is filled with teeny tiny particles found inside marine sponges that microscopically puncture the skin to create near-invisible channels that increase ingredient absorption. Hence why these are also referred to as microneedling in a bottle. You might feel a little tingling, but that means it's working!
 While creating a deeper penetration and absorption for your skincare, this formula is also filled with cica and hyaluronic acid to replenish the skin's moisture.
 One Cosmo editor says: "When I went to Seoul, I stocked up on this 'liquid microneedling' serum I'd seen all over TikTok. When I spread the serum across my face, it actually feels prickly, but that dissipates over a few hours. I usually swipe this on, then opt for an active ingredient like my go-to exfoliating serum. Using it once a week seriously has helped smooth the hell outta my skin, just as getting microneedling in office does for me." —BG
 Pros Helps all your other skincare absorb deeper while simultaneously moisturizing
 Cons Has a bit of a tingling sensation, but it goes away
 $23 at amazon.com 16) I'M From Rice Toner
 I'M From Rice Toner 
 Why we love it: Milky toners are the key to that coveted glass skin finish, and this one will hydrate and sweep the pores, all without breaking you out.
 One Cosmo editor says: "This toner is the perfect formula for my overly dry skin. It's infused with rice water to nourish and hydrate the skin while simultaneously cleaning my pores. A few swipes with a cotton pad will leave your skin looking like glass."—JH
 Pros Cosmo Acne Award winner
 Can be used with hands or cotton round
 Cons Available at limited retailers
 $28 at nordstrom.com 17) Illiyoon Ceramide Ato Lotion
 Illiyoon Ceramide Ato Lotion 
 Why we love it: This incredibly moisturizing (yet still lightweight feeling!) lotion is loaded with ceramides, which are key to maintaining a healthy skin barrier. It is also hypoallergenic, fragrance-free, and doesn't contain any potentially triggering ingredients that sensitive skin may dislike.
 One Cosmo editor says: "Seriously, since finding this, I haven't found another body lotion that quite compares—it's hypoallergenic, meaning it is fragrance-free and doesn't contain any potentially triggering ingredients that sensitive skin may dislike." —SIENA GAGLIANO, FORMER ASSOCIATE EDITOR
 Pros Great for any skin type, especially sensitive and reactive-prone
 Works well on body and face
 Cons Product recently jumped up in price
 $25 at amazon.com 18) CNP Laboratory CNP Honey Lip Butter
 CNP Laboratory CNP Honey Lip Butter 
 Why we love it: This CNP Laboratory lip mask is the best overnight treatment for dry, cracked lips. Infused with nourishing propolis and honey extracts, the buttery formula deeply hydrates and softens flakes. Unlike sticky balms that disappear after an hour, this one actually locks in moisture overnight so you wake up with smooth lips.
 One Cosmo editor says: "As someone with chronically dry lips, I've tried basically every overnight lip treatment on the market, and this is one of the few that doesn't leave me waking up with dry, crusty lips by morning. I also love putting it on midday when my lips are in need of some extra shine." 
—JH
 Pros Not sticky
 Stays on all night
 Cons I wish it came in an unscented version
 $18 at amazon.com 19) SOME BY MI Super Miracle Spot Cream
 SOME BY MI Super Miracle Spot Cream 
 Why we love it: This spot treatment is ideal for stubborn breakouts or painful pimples. It tackles congested pores with a blend of AHA, BHA, and PHA to exfoliate and clear the skin. It's infused with soothing ingredients like tea tree and centella asiatica, so it also calms irritation while promoting smoother skin.
 One Cosmo editor says: "I'm finally on the outs of a months-long battle with my hormonal acne. But when I was in the depths of it, I used this constantly. It was the perfect spot treatment for an angry, inflamed zit. It's basically a rich ointment loaded with anti-inflammatory ingredients to help calm down a breakout. So it won't dry out my skin or leave me with a crusty patch. Instead, it helps slowly flatten my pimple in a few days." —BG
 Pros Great for all types of acne
 Cons Those with sensitive skin should use it once or twice a week only
 $16 at amazon.com 20) Glow Recipe Watermelon Glow Toner
 Glow Recipe Watermelon Glow Toner 
 Why we love it: Glow Recipe is one of the internet's favorite skincare brands, but the pretty packaging isn't all that the shelf-worthy products have to offer. The fruity formulas are actually great for cleansing, hydrating, and treating the skin all while giving the eponymous glow. This toner won a Cosmo Readers' Choice Beauty Award two years in a row, and our editors love the skin-sweeping formula as well.
 One Cosmo editor says: "This toner is v gentle on my skin and is great for wiping the day off my face. I love using it at night after taking off my makeup when I feel like my pores need some extra love. It also isn't overly drying, which my skin appreciates." —JH
 Pros Doesn't dry out the skin
 Cons Watermelon scent might be too much for some
 $36 at amazon.com FAQs
 Why is Korean skincare so good?
 Korean skincare is so good because K-beauty brands embody a skin-first philosophy. "At a young age, Korean children are taught the importance of moisturizing, exfoliating, cleansing the skin thoroughly, and protecting their skin with SPF," says , K-beauty expert Charlotte Cho. The more time you invest in taking care of your skin and understanding what products and ingredients work for you, the better results you will see, she explains.
 K-beauty is also about accessibility. "The most innovative Korean skincare products do not break the bank—you can get effective ingredients and cutting-edge formulas that everyone can afford," Cho says. This philosophy ensures that everyone— regardless of budget—gets to prioritize the health of their skin.
 How to choose the best Korean skincare for you
 Evaluate the ingredients. 
 "Innovation and effectiveness have become synonymous with K-beauty; Korean skincare products are always searching for the best, most beneficial way to help treat and prevent concerns," Cho explains. Because this is the case, K-beauty brands are often pioneering a ton of new and exciting ingredients, textures, delivery systems, and categories (snail mucin! sorbet soft cleansing balms! cushion compacts! essences!).
 Advertisement Advertisement "Also, many of the ingredients that we've come to love and associate with Korean skincare come from hanbang, or in other words, traditional Korean medicine—ginseng, green tea, and lotus, all have long histories of being used in Korean remedies," Cho says.
 Understand that a 10-step routine is not necessary. 
 Each and every person's skin is unique, meaning some may benefit from a 10-step routine, and others may not. Cho agrees, "Learning about the 10 steps is a great educational resource and tool for you to understand what possibilities there are, but I firmly believe that the number of steps in your routine is up to the individual lifestyle, budget, and skin goals."
 Start slow. 
 After reading and learning about all of these incredible K-beauty products, I can understand why you may want to jump in and pop each and every one in your cart. But slow down! (1) Adding too much too soon can freak your skin out, and (2) let's be real, that's a sh-t-ton of money. Start slow and begin with a ritual that can be easily incorporated into your skincare routine. Cho's advice? Double-cleansing.
 "One of my favorite parts of my skincare routine is double-cleansing; it's the foundation of any skincare routine—the first step removes oil-based gunk, like sunscreen and makeup, and the second step ensures the remaining water-based gunk, like sweat and dirt, are gone," says Cho. She explains that this method is the best way to remove bacteria and oil that can lead to breakouts and premature aging.
 Meet the expert
 Charlotte Cho is the founder of the skincare line Then I Met You and cofounder of the incredibly popular K-beauty site Soko Glam .
 Why trust Cosmopolitan ?
 Jasmine Hyman is the assistant beauty editor at Cosmopolitan where she writes about all the best beauty products and trends. For this story, she, along with team Cosmo, tested dozens of products to narrow down the best K-beauty finds.
